minutes.headline: School Committee passed three facility-use, fundraising and school-space policies and moved renumbered policies along.
minutes.summary: The meeting opened with thanks to two departing members and a review of a survey on how the public understands the committee's role. The committee took line-item transfers, heard the superintendent's and student representative's reports, and read proclamations. It then handled policy readings and adjourned after committee reports.

what_happened.line: The committee took up policies 1202, 1303.3 and 3505 for a third reading and moved to approve them as read; the minutes record the result as not audible.
The committee moved to waive first reading of renumbered policies 1201, 1104 and 1106; the result was not audible, though the minutes record first reading as waived on the renumbered items.
The policy on school community relations was held back for another reading because its changes were substantial; first reading was not waived for it.
A line-item transfer would move leftover band music supply money at Turkey Hill to special education for a sensory pathway; the motion's result was not audible.
A transfer of grant money for the birth-to-8 program would pay the town rent for classroom space; the vote on the transfers was not audible.

why_it_matters: The facility rental policy sets a fixed hourly fee plus custodial and service costs, so what local groups pay to use school buildings depends on fees the committee sets.
Because the vote results were not audible in the recording, residents cannot confirm from these minutes that the transfers and policies were adopted; the official minutes would settle it.
